## Why This Is Asked
This question probes practical use of PostgreSQL RLS, dynamic masking, Secrets Manager, CMK encryption, and Aurora Global DB DR behavior. It tests ability to design isolation, security, backup/lags, and validation steps under regional failover.

- Dynamic data masking

```javascript
FOR ALL USING (tenant_id = CAST(current_setting('app.tenant') AS int));
```

